label: <DEL> delimiter in length-3 sequences (plus weak h at step 2-3)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only at the <DEL> delimiter of the shortest (L=3) sequences, at t=3. That one step holds about 85% of the activation mass and all of the strongest activations: the top quartile is 95% covered by the predicate. It is selective within that context, though: only about 42% of L=3 delimiter steps cross threshold. How strongly it fires depends on the specific original tokens in a spread-out way. Preceding tokens such as h, 2, u, k and 1 raise the rate, but no simple token set improved F1 (token-restricted versions scored F1 of about 0.45). A weaker secondary mode (about 15% of the mass, max about 0.2 of peak) fires on input h during the original phase at t=2 or t=3 (orig_idx 2-3) in sequences of any length. Never active in the copy phase, at t=0-1, at t>=5, or at the delimiter of sequences with L>=4.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 (+3.80), prev_tok=2 (+3.51), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=h (+3.12), phase=0 & in_tok=h (+3.12), t=2 & in_tok=h (+3.00), prev2_tok=2 (+2.84). Lower it: phase=0 (-3.64), orig0=e (-3.01), phase=2 (-2.88), orig0=i (-2.85).
